title: Carve 0.2 line shapes
description: The shapes a line can have in the block pass, keyed by the first character after the prefixes of the open containers (quote marks and indent). A shape is tested only on a line that starts with one of its `first` characters; `blank` and `text` have none. The order of `shapes` is by the lowest code point in `first`, then by name, and is not a priority. Several shapes can share a first character; the clauses decide between them.

clauses.description: The clause ids of the six 0.2 documents that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.

line_end.description: Where a line ends: at the terminator. The character named in `dropped_before_terminator`, directly before it, is not part of the line. A lone carriage return is content and ends no line.

name.description: The identifier of the row, unique in its list.

first.description: The characters the line can start with after the prefixes. An entry is one character or a range such as `a-z`. Empty for `blank` and `text`.

role.description: What a line of the shape does: `container` opens a container on its marker line, `opener` opens a fenced block, `closer` closes one, `opener_or_closer` closes an open div it is long enough for and otherwise opens one, `skipped` is the comment-only line, `close_fact` is a shape read when a paragraph closes and never a role of a line.

clauses.description: The clause ids of the six 0.2 documents that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.

sequence.description: What the line holds from its first character on. The shape matches when the whole sequence matches. When the last part is not `end`, the rest of the line is not constrained by this file. Absent for `text`, which is every line that matches nothing else.

line.description: The line of the document the shape is bound to, counted from 1.

column.description: The column the shape is bound to (C2-B-003).

container.description: `none`: the shape counts only outside every container.

requires.description: Facts of the container stack or of the line above that must hold. The cited clauses define each.

excludes.description: Cases in which a line that matches the sequence is not the shape.

refs.description: The forms that a `ref` part names, by name. A form with no shape field here has none stated in the documents.

name.description: The identifier of the row, unique in its list.

clauses.description: The clause ids of the six 0.2 documents that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.

file.description: The data file of this directory that defines the form.

values.description: The complete list of spellings, when the form is a closed list.

forms.description: The spellings of the form as the clause names them.

opener.description: The characters that start the form.

excluded.description: Characters. An entry is one character, or a range written as two characters joined by a hyphen, both ends included.

chars.description: Characters. An entry is one character, or a range written as two characters joined by a hyphen, both ends included.

not_first.description: Characters. An entry is one character, or a range written as two characters joined by a hyphen, both ends included.

roman_chars.description: Characters. An entry is one character, or a range written as two characters joined by a hyphen, both ends included.

quotes.description: Characters. An entry is one character, or a range written as two characters joined by a hyphen, both ends included.

one_letter_case.description: True when all letters of one marker are in one letter case.

valid_numeral_required.description: False when any run of roman letters is a marker, whether or not it is a well-formed numeral.

reads_escapes.description: True when a backslash escapes inside the form.

min.description: The lowest count of characters or repeats.

glued.description: True when the repeats stand with no character between them.

part.description: One part of a sequence. `part` selects the kind.

chars.description: Characters. An entry is one character, or a range written as two characters joined by a hyphen, both ends included.

min.description: The lowest length. With `min_from`, the lowest length in every case.

max.description: The highest length. Absent: no upper bound.

same.description: True when the run repeats one character.

min_from.description: The run is at least as long as the run of the opener it closes.

max.description: The highest count. Absent: no upper bound.

has_non_space.description: True when at least one character is not a space.

ref.description: The identifier of the row, unique in its list.

sequence.description: Parts in order, each directly behind the one before.

oneOf.description: A sequence that may be absent as a whole.

items.description: Parts in order, each directly behind the one before.

oneOf.description: Exactly one of the sequences. An empty sequence is the choice of nothing.
